description: MCD v6.2 diurnal profiles at the Perseverance landing site, Jezero, from the LMD web interface
local_time: local true solar time at the site longitude (MCD user manual v6.1, Table 1); hour axis verified against the MCD loctime variable

t.label: Air temperature at 1.45 m above the local surface

fluxsurf_dn_sw.label: Incident solar flux on a horizontal surface

fluxsurf_lw.label: Thermal infrared flux on the surface

tauref.label: Daily mean dust column visible optical depth

as_of_note: as_of is the month the values were served by the MCD 6.2 interface: the 6.2 release date is not stated on the LMD pages (the v6.1 user manual is dated October 2022 and the 6.2 interface serves scenarios through Martian Year 37), so it could not be used; to be corrected when LMD states it.
